_doc: ROADMAP 7.1n1: twins of the program hunks (program S_16/17/22/24/26 = mog S_21/22/27/29/31). A twin re-uses the struct type of its program entry; 'share' (no pointer cells) makes the mog labels alias the program's object, so the engine data exists once (image_tab re-initialises it at each overlay entry, as the loader's re-read did). mog S_39 is NOT a twin of program S_32 (different layout). See program.data.json.
